purpose: Real generation image identity consistency validation bridging Level 3 production-ready engines to generation output QA.

character_identity.description: Facial features, body proportions, and recognizable character markers remain stable across generated frames.

location_identity.description: Spatial layout, set geography, and environmental anchors remain consistent within a location sequence.

lighting_identity.description: Key/fill/rim balance, color temperature, and shadow direction remain coherent across shots.

costume_identity.description: Wardrobe silhouette, palette, and accessory placement remain stable for each character.

prop_identity.description: Story-critical objects retain shape, scale, and visual markers across callbacks and re-entries.

style_identity.description: Rendering style, grain, palette grading, and artistic treatment remain within the declared style envelope.

composition_identity.description: Framing grammar, subject placement, and negative-space balance remain intentional across coverage roles.

camera_identity.description: Lens feel, focal length cues, and camera motion vocabulary remain consistent with shot coverage intent.
